title: A Phase 2/3 Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy of Brepocitinib in Adults with Lichen Planopilaris (ALPINE)
official: A Phase 2/3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy of Oral Brepocitinib in Adults with Lichen Planopilaris
summary:
Main objective: Phase II: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of brepocitinib in participants with LPP
Phase III: To evaluate the efficacy of brepocitinib for the treatment of LPP, in comparison to placebo
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female participants aged ≥ 18
2. Biopsy consistent with LPP
3. Must have active LPP
4. Weight > 40 kg to < 130 kg and body mass index (BMI) ≤ 45 kg/m2.
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of or have: Lymphoproliferative disorder; active malignancy; cancer within 5 years prior to randomization, with the exception of basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast, carcinoma in situ of the uterine cervix, or thyroid carcinoma; thrombosis or cerebrovascular ischemic event within the last 12 months; a high risk for herpes zoster reactivation; active or recent infections.
